description.p: UniDB is a fast, native desktop database studio for Linux built with Rust, GTK4, and libadwaita with encrypted local credential storage and strict safety controls.

ul.li: Connect to SQLite, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra, and MSSQL.
Browse schemas and tables, inspect foreign key ERDs, and run explain plans or bar charts.
Write and run SQL in GtkSourceView or generate queries visually with the Query Builder.
Design tables, run numbered SQL migrations, snapshot and compare table state, and share signed team bundles.
Run offline Schema Doctor checks, scheduled jobs, sandboxed WASM plugins, and offline first sync queues.

description.p: Initial v0.1.0 release with all 9 database engines, SQL editor, ERD schema map, migrations, snapshots, signed team bundles, schema doctor, scheduled jobs, WASM plugins, and offline sync.
